'''Lan Crish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Brotherhood were hired to steal a cargo of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] that a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] were transporting to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] [[House D'Vails]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. Crish's boss, [[Dacr Vrolm]], provided Crish with details of when and where the agents were to arrive, and Crish and a group of pirates set out for [[docking bay 1138]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Taggon]], where the agents were scheduled to land. When the agents eventually arrived and docked their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the bay, Crish approached them and posed as a representative of House D'Vails, in an attempt to trick them into handing the detonators over to him.
